set_name: Chlamydomonas ODA16/DNAAF18 - IFT46 external positive benchmark
evidence_basis: Taschner et al. 2017: PDB 5MZH and ITC Kd about 200 nM.
expected_result: Should be positive if Chlamydomonas sequences are supplied and the workflow is calibrated.
rationale: Gold-standard algal direct structural/biochemical positive control.
notes: External benchmark only because the verified target universe is human.

evidence_basis: Wang et al. 2020: purified human ODA16 and IFT46 failed to interact by SEC and pulldown.
expected_result: Expected low confidence or no plausible interface.
rationale: Practical first negative/species-divergence control using verified human targets.
notes: Replaces DNAAF19-IFT as the first practical negative control.

evidence_basis: Issa et al. 2025: IP-MS/co-IP plus ternary ODA-Shulin and IFT74/81 SEC context; IFT74/81 are an obligate module.
expected_result: Should be one of the strongest candidate runs; directness remains unresolved.
rationale: Primary DNAAF9 test should use the IFT74/IFT81 heterodimer context, not isolated binaries.
notes: Do not treat DNAAF9-IFT74 or DNAAF9-IFT81 isolated binaries as primary tests.

evidence_basis: Girish refinement: tests DNAAF9 against a broader IFT-B cargo-adaptor context.
expected_result: Potentially informative; no direct binary evidence.
rationale: Adds IFT46 to the DNAAF9-IFT74/81 context to probe a more complete IFT-B module.
notes: Run as multichain if supported; otherwise use fallback decompositions only as secondary diagnostics.

evidence_basis: Girish refinement: new IFT-B context suggested for first RunPod exploration.
rationale: Tests whether DNAAF9 has plausible contacts with a second IFT-B subcomplex context.
notes: New candidate; interpret positive predictions cautiously.

evidence_basis: Dai et al. 2018 supports ODA cargo transport by IFT; no direct DNAI1-IFT binary shown.
expected_result: Potentially informative; not expected as a known direct binary.
rationale: Tests an ODA intermediate-chain cargo contact hypothesis in an IFT46/74/81 context.
notes: Full-length first-pass is allowed, but domain/fragments may be better after review.

evidence_basis: Dai et al. 2018 supports DNAI2/IC2 transport by IFT; no direct DNAI2-IFT binary shown.
expected_result: Potentially informative; not expected as a known direct binary.
rationale: Tests the better-supported ODA intermediate-chain cargo reporter against IFT46/74/81.
notes: Full-length first-pass is allowed, but domain/fragments may be better after review.

evidence_basis: Girish refinement: tests the DNAI1/DNAI2 intermediate-chain pair in a larger IFT-B context.
expected_result: Potentially informative; requires careful multichain handling.
rationale: Represents the ODA intermediate-chain pair rather than isolated DNAI1 or DNAI2 against IFT proteins.
notes: Run as multichain if supported; fallback rows split the context without pretending they are equivalent.

evidence_basis: Girish refinement: new ODA intermediate-chain pair against an IFT80/IFT172 context.
rationale: Tests whether the DNAI1/DNAI2 pair has plausible contacts with IFT80/IFT172.
notes: New candidate; requires multichain input handling.

evidence_basis: Prior evidence audit: no direct DNAH-IFT interaction and full-length DNAH5 is about 4624 aa.
expected_result: Do not run full-length in first RunPod pass.
rationale: Heavy-chain tests require truncation/domain design before execution.

evidence_basis: Prior evidence audit: no direct DNAH-IFT interaction and full-length DNAH9 is about 4486 aa.
expected_result: Do not run full-length in first RunPod pass.
rationale: Heavy-chain tests require truncation/domain design before execution.
